HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0001.title: Ensure snippet custom content remains legible

statement.en: Ensure a snippet's custom content remains legible against the system background.
statement.ja: snippetのcustom contentをsystem backgroundに対して読みやすく保つ。

conditions: Check sufficient contrast in both light and dark appearances.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0001.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Ensure directive and concretized the light-and-dark contrast outcome.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0002.title: Keep snippet content concise

statement.en: Keep snippet content short and easy to read.
statement.ja: snippet contentを短く読みやすく保つ。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0002.review_note: Recovered both brevity and easy-legibility outcomes from the supporting source context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0003.title: Give a confirmation snippet's primary button a descriptive label

statement.en: Give a confirmation snippet's primary button a descriptive label.
statement.ja: confirmation snippetのprimary buttonに説明的なlabelを付ける。

conditions: Use an appropriate system label or provide a custom label.
If no label is specified, the system uses Continue.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0003.review_note: Replaced generic generated wording and recorded the system, custom, and default label paths.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0004.title: Communicate a snippet's purpose visually

statement.en: Use the custom view to communicate a snippet's purpose visually.
statement.ja: custom viewを使ってsnippetの目的を視覚的に伝える。

conditions: The spoken app-intent dialogue remains essential when someone isn't looking at the screen.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0004.review_note: Made the visual communication mechanism explicit while preserving spoken-dialogue context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0005.title: Keep consistent margins within a snippet custom view

statement.en: Keep content margins consistent within a snippet's custom view.
statement.ja: snippetのcustom view内でcontent marginを一貫させる。

conditions: Consistent margins clarify layout and support quick interpretation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0005.review_note: Split the independent margin outcome from the contrast check in the same source sentence.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0006.title: Keep snippet custom views at or below 400 points

statement.en: Ensure a snippet custom view doesn't exceed 400 points in height.
statement.ja: snippetのcustom viewを高さ400 point以下にする。

conditions: The maximum helps keep all custom-view content visible.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0006.review_note: Classified the explicit no-taller-than 400-point maximum as a platform-contract MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0007.title: Account for preferred text sizes in snippet content

statement.en: When deciding how much text to include in a snippet, account for people's preferred text sizes.
statement.ja: snippetに含めるtext量を決める際は利用者のpreferred text sizeを考慮する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0007.review_note: Recovered the Dynamic Type context without promoting Be mindful language to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0008.title: Deep-link detailed result content to the app

statement.en: When a result snippet needs more detail, deep-link to the app instead of adding it to the custom view.
statement.ja: result snippetで詳細が必要な場合はcustom viewへ追加せずappへdeep linkする。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0008.review_note: Recovered the result-snippet condition and the explicit in-app alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0009.title: Don't rely on dialogue text to convey a snippet's purpose

statement.en: Avoid relying on displayed dialogue text to convey a snippet's purpose.
statement.ja: snippetの目的を伝えるために表示dialogue textだけへ依存しない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0009.review_note: Kept the explicit Don't directive at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0010.title: Prefer omitting dialogue text from a snippet's visual view

statement.en: Prefer omitting dialogue text from a snippet's visual representation.
statement.ja: snippetのvisual representationからdialogue textを省くことを優先する。

conditions: Use the custom view to convey the visual information instead.
exceptions: Spoken app-intent dialogue remains essential when someone isn't looking at the screen.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0010.review_note: Preserved the Prefer strength and the distinction between visual omission and spoken accessibility.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0011.title: Avoid snippets on unsupported platforms

statement.en: Avoid using snippets on tvOS, visionOS, or watchOS.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0011.review_note: Recorded the descriptive platform limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.
